blocks.text: Jojo Bragais, the popular international pageant shoe designer who is now the president of the Reina Filipinas organization, acknowledged the public’s sentiments about the Miss Grand International competition. But he said he is standing firm on his resolve to continue supporting the Philippines’ bet Angelica Lopez. Many Filipino pageant fans aired their disappointment at the Philippines’ failure to secure a Top 4 spot for the 2026 Miss Grand International pageant’s “Country’s Power of the Year” poll, and said Bragais and his organization should not have spent a lot for the paid voting scheme. “I see passionate expressions of disapproval towards some […]...
